command:
set -euo pipefail; d=$(find /artifacts/clay-entityos-swarm -maxdepth 1 -type d -name 'active-*' | sort | tail -1); echo RUN_DIR=$d; sleep 2; python3 - "$d/workers.jsonl" <<'PY'
import json,sys,collections,pathlib
p=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]); rows=[]
if p.exists():
 for line in p.open(errors='replace'):
  try: rows.append(json.loads(line))
  except: pass
print('records',len(rows))
print('providers',dict(collections.Counter(str(r.get('provider')) for r in rows)))
print('statuses',dict(collections.Counter(str(r.get('http_status')) for r in rows)))
print('success_models',dict(collections.Counter(str(r.get('model')) for r in rows if isinstance(r.get('http_status'),int) and 200 <= r['http_status'] < 300)))
print('input_tokens',sum(int((r.get('usage') or {}).get('input_tokens',(r.get('usage') or {}).get('prompt_tokens',0)) or 0) for r in rows))
print('output_tokens',sum(int((r.get('usage') or {}).get('output_tokens',(r.get('usage') or {}).get('completion_tokens',0)) or 0) for r in rows))
PY
echo '--- status ---'; cat "$d/status.json" 2>/dev/null || true
